text:
GENERATE BURST BV3-1 -- Run C-9 Phase 2, lane BV3: a LOOSE CONCEPT SKETCH of a whole combat SITE for a winter game level, seen from above. task_id "BV3-1".

SITE: an old royal burial ground on open snowy moorland, low barrows scattered in the snow beyond the ring.

LAYOUT (the fixed geometry, identical in every concept): seen from high above at about 53 degrees down, like a fixed overhead game camera, NORTH AT THE TOP of the frame. In the middle, a broad FLAT OPEN floor of snow, empty and uncluttered, about two-thirds of the frame wide, ringed by ONE low line of small standing stones (knee-to-waist height, evenly spaced, the ring reading as a wide oval because of the camera tilt). Five spawn sources stand just OUTSIDE the ring: one at the top (NORTH, the grandest and largest, where the bosses enter), one at the left (WEST), one at the bottom (SOUTH), one at the right (EAST), and one at the lower right (SOUTH-EAST) close beside the east one, so east and south-east read as a near pair. A sixth, ambush source lies INSIDE the ring, a little up and to the left of centre (north-west of centre), small, so the rest of the floor stays open. Each source is a distinct, readable landmark at small size; leave the space between them as plain snow.

THE SIX SOURCES: NORTH (top): a huge long barrow, the largest object in the frame, with a massive stone doorway of two thick uprights and a heavy lintel, facing the ring. WEST (left): a small round barrow, low and modest, its small doorway toward the ring. SOUTH (bottom): a long low barrow lying along the ring, its door toward the ring. EAST (right): a barrow whose roof has collapsed into a dark sunken hollow of tumbled stones and timber. SOUTH-EAST (lower right, close beside the east one): a barrow with TWO doorways side by side. The barrows differ in SIZE and STATE, not in decoration. AMBUSH (inside the ring, north-west of centre): a small patch of shallow graves -- low snow-covered humps with a few tilted, leaning grave-stones.

HAND: a loose concept sketch, not a finished painting -- a varying dark warm-brown ink line (bolder on outer contours, lighter inside), transparent watercolour washes, cream paper left showing as the highlights, a cold winter palette of blue-white snow and warm grey stone, one low warm winter sun from the upper LEFT with short soft blue-violet shadows. Few specifics; the big shapes clear. IMAGE 1 is a reference for palette, light, snow and painted hand ONLY -- not its layout or its objects.

No characters, no creatures, no people, no text, lettering, labels, numbers, arrows, compass, UI, border or frame.

Exactly ONE image_gen call (generate, landscape 1536x1024). Do not retry inside this burst. Copy the output to out/BV3-1.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "BV3-1"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 -- a painted chunk of the approved Barrow area: palette, light, snow and painted hand ONLY, not its layout
